description: Given a small Python repository containing a hardcoded API key string, replace every hardcoded occurrence with `os.environ['API_KEY']` and add `import os` where needed. The repository must still be importable (no syntax errors) and all pre-existing tests must still pass.
oracle_rules: grep for the literal old key value ('sk-prod-ABCDEF12345') returns 0 hits across the repo
the string `os.environ["API_KEY"]` OR `os.environ['API_KEY']` appears at least once
`pytest -q` in the repo returns exit code 0

tool_catalog.shell: run a shell command in the workspace root; returns combined stdout+stderr + exit code
tool_catalog.read_file: read a text file by path
tool_catalog.write_file: overwrite a text file by path with new contents
tool_catalog.finish: no-op; indicates the model believes the task is complete

constraints: edits must stay inside the workspace directory
the model may NOT invoke pip, git, or any network command
no new files may be created outside src/ or tests/
